name: Shanthi Gears Limited
summary: Shanthi Gears Limited designs, manufactures, supplies, and services gears and gear boxes in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company provides helical and bevel helical, worm, extruder, and cooling tower gear boxes, planetary gear boxes, as well as geared motors. It also offers gears and pinions; special gearboxes; and iron, grey iron castings, phosphor bronze, aluminum bronze, leaded bronze, and copper alloy castings. In addition, the company provides installation support, refurbishment, and on-site services.
